name: Detección de Bandas de Color
description: Detects posterization and quantization artifacts in smooth gradients. AI images may show subtle color banding due to limited color depth in generated content.
algorithm: Gradient Step Detection + Banding Ratio Analysis
mechanism: Analyzes smooth gradient regions for discrete color steps by comparing adjacent pixel differences. Banding indicates quantization from AI generation or heavy compression.
parameters: Step detection threshold: 2, Gradient range: 3-40, Window: 5 pixels
useCase: Detecting color quantization artifacts in AI-generated images

references.title: Wang, Z. et al. (2004). Image Quality Assessment: From Error Visibility to Structural Similarity. IEEE TIP.
Daly, S. (1992). Visible Differences Predictor. SPIE Human Vision.
Lee, S. & Bovik, A.C. (2002). Fast Algorithms for Signal and Image Processing. IEEE TSP.

strengths:
• Effective at detecting posterization and quantization artifacts
• Reveals bit-depth reduction from processing
• Complementary to gradient and histogram methods
• Works across all image formats
• Low computational cost
limitations:
• Natural smooth gradients may trigger false positives
• Display calibration affects visual verification
• Less effective on high-bit-depth images (16-bit)
• Heavy dithering can mask banding artifacts
• Subtle banding may be below detection threshold
